description: §41.12.1 / §55.10 Level 2 — registered message TEMPLATES fill their named slots at `<errors of=>`, for every ValidationError variant a markup validator produces (13 of the 15; NotSome and Custom are covered by the unit tier). Each field fails one validator; its rendered message is the registered template with `{field}` = the leaf field name and the variant's §55.9 payload slot filled: `{predicate}` → `>= 2`, `{re}` → the pattern as written, `{threshold}`, `{expected}`, `{forbidden}` → the value, `{set}` → the elements joined by `, `. `{{` renders a literal `{` and a lone `}` is text (`pin must be {1234}`).
rationale: S462 ruling (user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package", item 2): registerMessages values are message templates with named slots, not functions. The registered templates are DEVELOPER-AUTHORED source, so their rendering is normative and asserted verbatim; the slot table (field + the §55.9 payload names) and the rendering rules are §41.12.1 rules 3-4. The validator inputs mirror the vocab-*-invalid sibling cases. PAYLOAD-SHAPE NOTE: §55.9 declares LengthFailed's payload `predicate: string`; impl#1 carries `{op, value}` and §41.12.1 rule 4 renders it `<op> <value>` — both shapes render `>= 2`.

domAnchored.text: role must be one of Admin, Editor
